Image 2 is the exact current Wu combat sprite: use its clean simplified hand-painted anime hard-edge shadow shapes, large opaque colour blocks, legible face and minimal surface detail. Redraw the character in this combat-sprite treatment while preserving the character's own face, hair, outfit and props. Not chibi, realistic body proportions. All contours/props fully inside canvas with at least 5% padding. Front three-quarter camera, oriented subtly toward screen-right. Subject occupies 78% canvas height and is centered, ground baseline at 91% canvas height, ample horizontal room for later animation. Neutral relaxed combat pose, stable silhouette, subtle expression; original costume proportions. No glow haze or background shadows.
Character: Female mage Baita: gentle green eyes, dark brown long loose curls grouped into simple large shapes, gold hair clip, white long-sleeve blouse, dark forest-green suspender ankle-length skirt, white socks and black Mary Jane shoes. Keep her seated on a simplified dark carved wooden armchair, feet resting on ground. One ancient gilded closed book rests on her lap; two small open books float near her shoulders. Hands calmly poised above the lap book ready to cast, no cake or fork for combat. Entire chair and feet visible. No floor magic circle, no scattered particles. Keep seated reference identity.
